# Arnav Jain - Data Science & AI Developer
> Portfolio: https://arnavjaindev.vercel.app/

Arnav Jain is a Data Science and AI Developer dedicated to forging robust data architectures and breathing life into complex systems through generative, intelligent models.

## Key Projects
- Global Nav Plexus: An interactive, graph-based 3D geospatial routing engine visualising optimal paths on a custom WebGL globe with high-performance C++17 REST API backend.
- Persona AI Co-Pilot: Client-side AI portfolio representative with Gemini API integration and hybrid offline/cloud database synchronization.

## Tech Stack
- Backend: C++, Python
- Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Three.js, WebGL
- AI / ML: Gemini API, TensorFlow, Generative Models
- Databases: Firebase Firestore, Local Storage

## Education & Background
